title: Answer: feeling and self without brainstem interoception

statements.text: The account would be weakened by consciousness and self-awareness that survive destruction of the interoceptive brainstem nuclei, by consciousness in organisms with no means to represent their own bodies, or by cortical damage alone abolishing core self-awareness. The insula lesion test was of this kind and the account survived it.

sources.quote: if these structures are not critical, R should show largely preserved SA
